```python
def parse_inline_spoiler(inline: 'InlineParser', m: Match[str], state:
    'InlineState') ->int:
    text = m.group('spoiler_text')
    children, end_pos = inline.parse(text, state)
    token = {'type': 'inline_spoiler', 'children': children}
    state.append_token(token)
    return m.end()
```
